summary: Visual mockup of the complete 2-page Janma Patrike PDF template. Page 1 (Front) shows header, personal details with father/mother/gotra, full panchanga with ghati details, planetary table, and 3 South Indian kundali charts. Page 2 (Back) shows nakshatra/dasha ghati details, Vimshottari Mahadasha table with 9 dashas, and Antardasha sub-periods.
